mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_order_request ( request_id, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, order_id, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{showId}, #{sessionId}, #{ticketCategoryId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{orderId}, #{failReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, order_id, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT id, request_id, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, order_id, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order_request WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, request_id, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, order_id, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'SUCCESS', order_id = #{orderId}, fail_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE ticket_order_request SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
